concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading and filtering from BOTH the CodeTrans AND BigCode datasets. T001 only fetches `codeparrot/code-trans-py-js` with vague 'supplemental CodeTrans splits'; no task touches `bigcode/evaluation` (named in spec assumptions). Partial-coverage gap for FR-001.

FR-003 requires translating the original Python unit tests to JavaScript and executing them. No task performs test translation; T006/T007 substitute empirical I/O-pair extraction. Even if this substitution is the plan's intent, the tasks list contains no task covering the spec's stated mechanism, and no task documents the deviation in a changelog as Constitution VII requires.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies note vs plan.md:Constitution Check III/V
concerns.text: Plan commits to `code/utils/checksum_artifacts.py` (Constitution III, Phase 0 Task 5) and `code/utils/update_state.py` (Constitution V) as constitution mechanisms. tasks.md explicitly declines to task them. The `update_state.py` exclusion may be defensible as platform-owned, but `checksum_artifacts.py` writing checksums under `data/` (per Constitution III: 'recorded under data/') is a project-owned obligation with no covering task.

The constitution requires a `requirements.txt` at `code/` pinning every Python dependency. No task creates or populates `requirements.txt`; T008 creates only `package.json`/`package-lock.json`. Constitution Principle I's reproducibility mechanism has no covering task.

Plan Phase 6 Task 4 (model_source stratification when Ollama fallback is used and equivalence verified) has no covering task: T010's six numbered items omit model-source stratification, and T007's validation_results.csv omits the `model_source` column the plan and translation_result.schema.yaml both specify.

T009 references 'the plan's mid-run checkpoint' but the plan's checkpoint is literally `[deferred]`/undefined (analyze report LOW item). No task defines the concrete trigger point (e.g., after N requests), so the fallback-coverage element of the plan is only nominally covered.

T007 claims `validation_results.csv` conforms to `translation_result.schema.yaml`, but the schema requires `generated_js`, `complexity_score`, `lines_of_code`, `raw_response`, `seed`, `timestamp` as mandatory fields while T007's declared columns are only `snippet_id`, `condition_name`, `test_pass_status`, `execution_time`. Either the task must emit the full schema or the contract must be revised — as written the conformance claim is unachievable.
